correctness.rationale: At the unique homogeneous equilibrium r=(1+exp(C_r-5c))^{-1}, S=c/r, differentiation yields modal blocks J_w with trace 1-r+delta w and determinant delta[r+(1-r)w], delta=5c(1-r). For real w in [-1,1], independently checked symbolically that Jury quantities equal r[1+delta(1-w)], 2-r+delta[r+(2-r)w], and 1-delta[r+(1-r)w]. They are strictly positive for delta<1 and all w, while uniform w=1 has product delta>1 for delta>1. At delta=1 every w<1 is strictly Schur stable and w=1 has a unit-circle conjugate pair. Elementary calculus of b/(1+exp(b-C_r)) gives the two Lambert-W boundary roots for C_r>2, tangency at C_r=2. This proves local linear statements only; nonlinear spiral dynamics are unaddressed.
residual_risks: Only symmetric nonnegative stochastic W and homogeneous equilibrium; disconnected cases may have repeated w=1 modes.
